en: Build 5 starts newly installed marketplace plugins without restarting the service, adds Wormhole to the bundled plugin marketplace, and simplifies WeType shared-space pairing. History search loads results progressively and highlights matches in the full content view. Action results with a link now show a QR code generated on the device. Settings and device management include restart actions, and update notes are localized and cumulative. On macOS, the background service now handles clipboard integration, the Quick Panel, pairing notifications, and update downloads and verification. On Windows, setup uses the native title bar. The main window expands around its center after setup. This build also refines the plugin marketplace layout, simplifies status messages in the Quick Panel, gives Shortcuts and Quick Panel distinct icons in Settings, and fixes Escape navigation in device management. All paired devices must use v2.
zh: Build 5 安装插件市场中的插件后可立即启动插件，无需重启服务。内置插件市场新增 Wormhole，微信输入法共享空间配对流程也更简洁。历史搜索逐步加载结果，并在完整内容视图中高亮匹配项。操作结果包含链接时，会显示在本机生成的二维码。设置和设备管理页新增重启操作。更新说明支持按语言显示，并可累积展示多个版本的变更。macOS 后台服务现在负责剪贴板集成、快捷面板、配对通知以及更新的下载和验证。Windows 初始化引导使用原生标题栏。完成初始化后，主窗口以原中心为基准扩大。本版本还优化了插件市场布局，简化了快捷面板的状态提示，为设置中的快捷键和快捷面板使用不同图标，并修复了设备管理页的 Esc 返回行为。所有配对设备必须使用 v2。
